<file path="AudioPlayerControlsMediator.js">
 1: import {ListEvents} from '../../core/EventBus.js';
 2: export const AudioPlayerControlsMediator = {
 3:     init(keyEventsCotrols, tracklistBrowser) {
 4:         this.keyValues = {
 5:             SPACE: ' ',
 6:             PLUS: '+',
 7:             MINUS: '-',
 8:             T: 't',
 9:             CAP_P: 'P',
10:             ArrowRight: 'ArrowRight',
11:             ArrowLeft: 'ArrowLeft',
12:         };
13:         this.tracklistBrowser = tracklistBrowser;
14:         this.keyEventsCotrols = keyEventsCotrols;
15:         this.listEvents = new ListEvents();
16:         this._setUpKeyBindings();
17:     },
18:     setPlayerControls(playerControls) {
19:         if (typeof playerControls === 'undefined') {
20:             const e = new Error('A player control is required!');
21:             console.error(e);
22:             throw e;
23:         }
24:         this.playerControls = playerControls;
25:     },
26:     playPause() {
27:         this.playerControls.playPause();
28:     },
29:     volumeUp() {
30:         this.playerControls.increaseVolume();
31:     },
32:     volumeDown() {
33:         this.playerControls.decreaseVolume();
34:     },
35:     nextTrack({ctrlKey, repeat}={}) {
36:         if (ctrlKey || repeat)
37:             return;
38:         this.playerControls.next();
39:     },
40:     prevTrack({ctrlKey, repeat}={}) {
41:         if (ctrlKey || repeat)
42:             return;
43:         this.playerControls.prev();
44:     },
45:     fastFoward({ctrlKey, repeat, shiftKey, type}={}) {
46:         if (ctrlKey && repeat || shiftKey && repeat) {
47:             this.playerControls.fastForward();
48:             this.listEvents.trigger('onFastForward');
49:         }
50:     },
51:     rewind({ctrlKey, repeat, shiftKey, type}={}) {
52:         if (ctrlKey && repeat || shiftKey && repeat) {
53:             this.playerControls.rewind();
54:             this.listEvents.trigger('onRewind');
55:         }
56:     },
57:     onFastForward(cb, subscriber) {
58:         this.listEvents.onEventRegister({cb, subscriber}, 'onFastForward');
59:     },
60:     onRewind(cb, subscriber) {
61:         this.listEvents.onEventRegister({cb, subscriber}, 'onRewind');
62:     },
63:     _setUpKeyBindings() {
64:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyUpAction(this.keyValues.SPACE, this.playPause.bind(this), this);
65:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyDownAction(this.keyValues.PLUS, this.volumeUp.bind(this), this);
66:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyDownAction(this.keyValues.MINUS, this.volumeDown.bind(this), this);
67:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyUpAction(this.keyValues.ArrowRight, this.nextTrack.bind(this), this);
68:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyUpAction(this.keyValues.ArrowLeft, this.prevTrack.bind(this), this);
69:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyDownAction(this.keyValues.ArrowRight, this.fastFoward.bind(this), this);
70:         this.keyEventsCotrols.registerKeyDownAction(this.keyValues.ArrowLeft, this.rewind.bind(this), this);
71:     }
72: }
</file>

<file path="AutoCompleteMediator.js">
 1: import {MetadataIndex} from '../../domain/MetadataIndex.js';
 2: import {TrackListManager} from "../../domain/TrackList.js";
 3: export const AutocompleteMediator = {
 4:     _lastLength: 0,
 5:     _activeInput: null, // Track the current DOM element
 6:     init(trackGrid) {
 7:         this.trackGrid = trackGrid;
 8:         this._lastLength = 0;
 9:         // Subscribe to the events defined in your TracklistGrid config
10:         this.trackGrid.onTrackArtistEditing((track, inputEl, val) => 
11:             this.handleInlineCompletion('artist', inputEl, val)
12:         , this);
13:         this.trackGrid.onTrackAlbumEditing((track, inputEl, val) => 
14:             this.handleInlineCompletion('album', inputEl, val)
15:         , this);
16:         TrackListManager.onTrackAddedToTrackList(MetadataIndex.addTrack.bind(MetadataIndex), this);
17:         TrackListManager.onRemoveTrackFromTrackList(MetadataIndex.removedTrack.bind(MetadataIndex), this);
18:     },
19:     handleInlineCompletion(field, inputEl, value, evt) {
20:         if (this._activeInput !== inputEl) {
21:             this._activeInput = inputEl;
22:             this._lastLength = 0; // Reset length tracking for new input
23:         }
24:         // 1. If user is deleting (backspace/selection delete), don't autocomplete
25:         if (value.length <= this._lastLength) {
26:             this._lastLength = value.length;
27:             return;
28:         }
29:         this._lastLength = value.length;
30:         // 2. Find a match in our local index
31:         const match = MetadataIndex.findMatch(field, value);
32:         if (match && match.length > value.length) {
33:             const originalLength = value.length;
34:             // 3. Update the value (programmatic change doesn't re-trigger 'input' usually)
35:             inputEl.value(match);
36:             // 4. The iTunes Magic: Select only the suggested part
37:             // Selection starts where the user stopped typing, and ends at the end of the match
38:             inputEl.setSelectionRange(originalLength, match.length);
39:         }
40:     },
41: };
</file>

<file path="MetadataMediator.js">
 1: import {Track} from '../../domain/models/Track.js';
 2: import {MetadataIndex} from '../../domain/MetadataIndex.js';
 3: export const MetadataMediator = {
 4:     init() {
 5:         Track.onTagChange(this._updateMetadataIndex.bind(this), this);
 6:     },
 7:     _updateMetadataIndex(tag, value, track) {
 8:         if (tag === 'artist' || tag === 'album') {
 9:             MetadataIndex.addKeyValue(tag, value);
10:         }
11:     }
12: };

<file path="PlaybackMediator.js">
 1: import { TrackListManager } from "../../domain/TrackList.js";
 2: export const PlaybackMediator = {
 3:     _comingNextFired: false,
 4:     init(tracklistBrowser, mainGrid, queueGrid, audioPlayer) {
 5:         this.browser = tracklistBrowser;
 6:         this.mainGrid = mainGrid;
 7:         this.queueGrid = queueGrid;
 8:         this.audioPlayer = audioPlayer;
 9:         // Listen for Global Track Events
10:         TrackListManager.onQueueFinished(() => this.handleQueueEnd());
11:         TrackListManager.onTrackListLoaded(() => this._initializeMainGrid());
12:         TrackListManager.onTrackChanged((track, index, isQueue, hasQueue) => this.handleTrackChange(track, index, isQueue, hasQueue));
13:         TrackListManager.onGridSyncRequired((track, index, isQueue, hasQueue) => this.handleTrackChange(track, index, isQueue, hasQueue));
14:         TrackListManager.onShuffleTracklist((track, index) => {
15:             this.mainGrid.redrawGrid();
16:             this.handleTrackChange(track, index, false, TrackListManager.queueList.length() > 0);
17:             if (this.audioPlayer.isPlayerPaused()) {
18:                 this.audioPlayer.setCurrentTrackFromTrackList(true, undefined, {track, index});
19:             }
20:         });
21:         this.queueGrid.onQueueRendered((row) => {
22:             this.handleNowPlaying(this.audioPlayer.isPlayerPaused(), row);
23:         });
24:         this.mainGrid.onDraggedTrackDropped((htmlItem, isQueuePlaying, draggedStartIndx, draggedEndIndx) => {
25:             TrackListManager.switchTrackIndex(draggedStartIndx, draggedEndIndx, isQueuePlaying);
26:             this.mainGrid._syncQueuePosition();
27:         });
28:         this.audioPlayer.onPlayPause((isPaused) => {
29:             const index = TrackListManager.getCurrentTrackIndex();
30:             const row = this.browser.getGrid().getRowByIndex(index);
31:             this.handleNowPlaying(isPaused, row);
32:         });
33:         this.audioPlayer.onStop(() => {
34:             const index = TrackListManager.getCurrentTrackIndex();
35:             const row = this.browser.getGrid().getRowByIndex(index);
36:             this.handleNowPlaying(true, row);
37:         });
38:     },
39:     async handleTrackChange(track, index, isQueue, hasQueue) {
40:         console.log('handleTrackChange', {track, index, isQueue, hasQueue});
41:         if (isQueue) {
42:             this.queueGrid.syncQueue(TrackListManager.queueList.length());
43:             this.browser.setGrid(this.queueGrid);
44:         } else {
45:             if (!hasQueue) 
46:                 this.queueGrid.deactivate();
47:             else
48:                 this.mainGrid._syncQueuePosition();
49:             this.browser.setGrid(this.mainGrid);
50:         }
51:         this.browser.setCurrentlyPlayingTrack(index);
52:         this.handleNowPlaying(this.audioPlayer.isPlayerPaused());
53:     },
54:     handleNowPlaying(isPaused, row) {
55:         this.browser.toggleNowPlaying(isPaused, row);
56:     },
57:     handleQueueEnd() {
58:         this.mainGrid.releaseQueueAnchor();
59:     },
60:     _initializeMainGrid() {
61:         this.mainGrid.setUp();
62:         this.mainGrid.buildGrid();
63:         this.mainGrid.render();
64:     },
65: }
</file>

<file path="PlaybackNotificationMediator.js">
 1: import { TrackListManager } from "../../domain/TrackList.js";
 2: import { PlayerNotifier } from "../Notifier.js";
 3: export const PlaybackNotificationMediator = {
 4:     init(audioPlayer, playerControls, playerProgressBar) {
 5:         this.audioPlayer = audioPlayer;
 6:         this.playerControls = playerControls;
 7:         this.playerProgressBar = playerProgressBar;
 8:         this._isNextTrackfired = false;
 9:         this._setupSubscriptions();
10:     },
11:     _setupSubscriptions() {
12:         // 1. Listen for the 30-second threshold (from AudioPlayer/PlayerManager)
13:         this.audioPlayer.onTrackNearEnd(this._handleNearEnd.bind(this), this);
14:         this.audioPlayer.onPlayerSongChange(this._hideNextTrackNotification.bind(this), this);
15:         this.audioPlayer.onPlayPause((isPaused, track) => {
16:             if (isPaused) return PlayerNotifier.pause();
17:             return PlayerNotifier.play();
18:         });
19:         this.playerControls.onPrevTrack(this._hideNextTrackNotification.bind(this), this);
20:         this.playerProgressBar.progressBar.onSeek((percent, mouseDown) => {
21:             if (!this.audioPlayer.isNearEnd())
22:                 this._hideNextTrackNotification();
23:             this.playerProgressBar.seek(percent, mouseDown);
24:         }, this);
25:         // 2. Listen for Queue Updates (The case you mentioned)
26:         TrackListManager.onAddedToQueue(this._handleQueueUpdate.bind(this), this);
27:         TrackListManager.onTrackIndexSwitch(this._handleSwitchTrack.bind(this), this);
28:     },
29:     _handleNearEnd() {
30:         if (this._isNextTrackfired) return;
31:         const currentTrack = this.audioPlayer.getCurrentTrack();
32:         const {track} = TrackListManager.getNextTrackInList();
33:         if (track && currentTrack) {
34:             PlayerNotifier.showNext(track, currentTrack.getTimeRemaining() * 1000);
35:             this._isNextTrackfired = true;
36:         }
37:     },
38:     _handleQueueUpdate() {
39:         if (!PlayerNotifier.isActive()) return;
40:         const currentTrack = this.audioPlayer.getCurrentTrack();
41:         const {track} = TrackListManager.getNextTrackInList();
42:         if (!track || !currentTrack) return;
43:         PlayerNotifier.hide(() => {
44:             PlayerNotifier.showNext(track, currentTrack.getTimeRemaining() * 1000);
45:         });
46:     },
47:     _handleSwitchTrack() {
48:         if (!this.audioPlayer.isNearEnd()) return;
49:         this._hideNextTrackNotification();
50:         this._handleNearEnd();
51:     },
52:     _hideNextTrackNotification() {
53:         if (!this._isNextTrackfired) return;
54:         this._isNextTrackfired = false;
55:         PlayerNotifier.hide();
56:     }
57: };
</file>

<file path="PlayerControlMediator.js">
  1: import { TrackListManager } from "../../domain/TrackList.js";
  2: import { ResourceManager } from "../../domain/StateManager.js";
  3: export const PlayerControlMediator = {
  4:     init(audioPlayer, playerDisplay, playerProgressBar, notifications, playerControls, keyControls, uiModules) {
  5:         this.audioPlayer = audioPlayer;
  6:         this.playerDisplay = playerDisplay;
  7:         this.playerProgressBar = playerProgressBar;
  8:         this.notifications = notifications;
  9:         this.playerControls = playerControls;
 10:         this.keyControls = keyControls;
 11:         this.uiModules = uiModules;
 12:         this.overlayDiv = document.querySelector('.cnt-overlay');
 13:         this._trackNearEndFired = false;
 14:         this._bindEvents();
 15:     },
 16:     _bindEvents() {
 17:         this._bindCorePlayerEvents();
 18:         this._bindUIInteractions();
 19:         this._bindKeyboardShortcuts();
 20:         this._bindSystemMediaSession();
 21:     },
 22:     _bindCorePlayerEvents() {
 23:         // Song Change
 24:         this.audioPlayer.onPlayerSongChange((track) => {
 25:             this.playerDisplay.setTrack(track);
 26:             this.playerProgressBar.resetProgressBar();
 27:             this.audioPlayer.setIsNearEnd(false)
 28:             this._trackNearEndFired = false;
 29:             this._preloadNextTrackArt();
 30:             this._updateSystemMetadata(track);
 31:         });
 32:         this.audioPlayer.onTrackTimeReset(() => {
 33:             this.playerProgressBar.resetProgressBar();
 34:         }, this);
 35:         // Time Update (Coming Next logic)
 36:         this.audioPlayer.onTimeUpdate((evt) => {
 37:             const { currentTime, duration } = evt.target;
 38:             if (isNaN(duration)) return;
 39:             if (duration === 0)
 40:                 return this.audioPlayer.currentTrack?.setCurrentTime(0);
 41:             this.audioPlayer.currentTrack?.setCurrentTime(currentTime);
 42:             const isNearEnd = (duration - currentTime <= 30);
 43:             this.audioPlayer.setIsNearEnd(isNearEnd);
 44:             if (isNearEnd && !this._trackNearEndFired) {
 45:                 this.audioPlayer.audioPlayerEvents.trigger('onTrackNearEnd');
 46:                 this._trackNearEndFired = true;
 47:             }
 48:         });
 49:     },
 50:     _bindUIInteractions() {
 51:         this._setAudioElementEvents();
 52:         // Backdrop click to close modals
 53:         this.overlayDiv.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 54:             if (e.target === e.currentTarget) this._closeAllActiveWindows(e);
 55:         });
 56:         // Handle left menu buttons
 57:         this.fileBrowserElem = document.querySelector('#file-browser-action button.open-file-browser');
 58:         this.gridElement = document.querySelector('#file-browser-action button.open-tracklist-browser');
 59:         this.playlistCreationElement = document.querySelector('#file-browser-action button.open-playlist-create');
 60:         this.fileBrowserElem.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
 61:             this._showBackDrop();
 62:             this.uiModules.fileBrowser.loadFileBrowser.bind(this.uiModules.fileBrowser)(evt);
 63:         });
 64:         this.gridElement.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
 65:             this._showBackDrop();
 66:             this.uiModules.tracklistGrid.open(evt);
 67:         });
 68:         this.playlistCreationElement.addEventListener('click', this._displayPlaylistCreationUI.bind(this));
 69:         // Player state sync
 70:         this.audioPlayer.onPlayPause((isPaused, track) => {
 71:             this.playerProgressBar.togglePauseProgress(isPaused);
 72:             this._updateSystemMetadata(track);
 73:         });
 74:         this.audioPlayer.onStop(this.playerProgressBar.resetProgressBar.bind(this.playerProgressBar));
 75:         this.audioPlayer.onRepeatSwitch((repeatMode) => {
 76:             this._preloadNextTrackArt();
 77:             TrackListManager.switchRepeatMode(repeatMode);
 78:         }, this);
 79:     },
 80:     _setAudioElementEvents() {
 81:         this.audioPlayer.audioElem.onloadedmetadata = () => {
 82:             this.playerProgressBar.doProgress(this.audioPlayer.getCurrentTime(), this.audioPlayer.getDuration());
 83:         };
 84:     },
 85:     _bindKeyboardShortcuts() {
 86:          this.keyControls.registerKeyDownAction('m', async () => {
 87:             await this.audioPlayer.mute();
 88:             this.playerDisplay.showMuteOverlay(this.audioPlayer.isMuted());
 89:         }, this);
 90:         ['+', '-'].forEach(key => {
 91:             this.keyControls.registerKeyDownAction(key, () => {
 92:                 // When key is held down, just show/reset the UI
 93:                 this.playerDisplay.showVolumeOverlay(this.audioPlayer.getVolume());
 94:             }, this);
 95:             this.keyControls.registerKeyUpAction(key, () => {
 96:                 // When key is released, start the fade out
 97:                 this.playerDisplay.hideVolumeOverlay();
 98:             }, this);
 99:         });
100:         this.keyControls.registerKeyDownAction('t', () => {
101:             this.playerDisplay.changeTrackTimeDisplayMode();
102:         });
103:         const {tracklistGrid, playlistCreation} = this.uiModules;
104:         this.keyControls.registerKeyDownAction('a', () => {
105:             this._showBackDrop();
106:             tracklistGrid.open();
107:         }, tracklistGrid);
108:         this.keyControls.registerKeyDownAction('n', this._displayPlaylistCreationUI.bind(this), playlistCreation);
109:         this.keyControls.registerKeyDownAction('Escape', (evt) => {
110:             this._hideBackDrop();
111:             this._closeAllActiveWindows(evt.evt);
112:         }, 'BYPASS_EXCLUSIVITY');
113:     },
114:     _displayPlaylistCreationUI(evt) { 
115:         if (evt instanceof Event)
116:             evt.stopPropagation();
117:         const {playlistCreation} = this.uiModules;
118:         this._showBackDrop();
119:         playlistCreation.show();
120:         const modalElement = playlistCreation.getHTMLItem().render();
121:         modalElement.onclick = (evt) => evt.stopPropagation();
122:         playlistCreation.onPlaylistCreated((res) => {
123:             this._hideBackDrop();
124:             this._closeAllActiveWindows();
125:         }, this);
126:         this.overlayDiv.append(modalElement);
127:         this.keyControls.setExclusivityCallerKeyUpV2(playlistCreation);
128:         this.keyControls.setExclusivityCallerKeyDownV2(playlistCreation);
129:     },
130:     _bindSystemMediaSession() {
131:         if (!('mediaSession' in navigator)) return;
132:         navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('play', () => this.audioPlayer.playPause());
133:         navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('pause', () => this.audioPlayer.playPause());
134:         navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('previoustrack', () => this.audioPlayer.prev());
135:         navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('nexttrack', () => this.audioPlayer.next());
136:     },
137:     _showBackDrop() {
138:         this.overlayDiv.style.display = 'block';
139:     },
140:     _hideBackDrop() {
141:         this.overlayDiv.style.display = 'none';
142:     },
143:     _updateSystemMetadata(track) {
144:         document.title = `${track.getTitle()} - ${track.getArtist()}`;
145:         if (!('mediaSession' in navigator)) return;
146:         navigator.mediaSession.metadata = new MediaMetadata({
147:             title: track.getTitle(),
148:             artist: track.getArtist(),
149:             album: track.getAlbum(),
150:             artwork: [{ src: ResourceManager.getAlbumArtURL(track) }]
151:         });
152:     },
153:     _closeAllActiveWindows(e) {
154:         this.overlayDiv.style.display = 'none';
155:         Object.values(this.uiModules).forEach(m => {
156:             m.close?.(e) || m.hide?.(e) || m.setVisible?.(false);
157:         });
158:         this.keyControls.unsetExclusivityCallerKeyUpV2(this.uiModules.playlistCreation);
159:         this.keyControls.unsetExclusivityCallerKeyDownV2(this.uiModules.playlistCreation);
160:     },
161:     _preloadNextTrackArt() {
162:         const next = TrackListManager.getNextTrackInList();
163:         if (next?.track) ResourceManager.preloadAlbumArt(next.track);
164:     },
165: }
</file>
